entries.title: Revelation of John 11:1
segments: And there was given me a reed like unto a rod: and one said, Rise, and measure the temple of God, and the altar, and them that worship therein.

entries.title: Revelation of John 11:2
segments: And the court which is without the temple leave without, and measure it not; for it hath been given unto the nations: and the holy city shall they tread under foot forty and two months.

entries.title: Revelation of John 11:3
segments: And I will give unto my two witnesses, and they shall prophesy a thousand two hundred and threescore days, clothed in sackcloth.

entries.title: Revelation of John 11:4
segments: These are the two olive trees and the two candlesticks, standing before the Lord of the earth.

entries.title: Revelation of John 11:5
segments: And if any man desireth to hurt them, fire proceedeth out of their mouth and devoureth their enemies; and if any man shall desire to hurt them, in this manner must he be killed.

entries.title: Revelation of John 11:6
segments: These have the power to shut the heaven, that it rain not during the days of their prophecy: and they have power over the waters to turn them into blood, and to smite the earth with every plague, as often as they shall desire.

entries.title: Revelation of John 11:7
segments: And when they shall have finished their testimony, the beast that cometh up out of the abyss shall make war with them, and overcome them, and kill them.

entries.title: Revelation of John 11:8
segments: And their dead bodies [lie] in the street of the great city, which spiritually is called Sodom and Egypt, where also their Lord was crucified.

entries.title: Revelation of John 11:9
segments: And from among the peoples and tribes and tongues and nations do [men] look upon their dead bodies three days and a half, and suffer not their dead bodies to be laid in a tomb.

entries.title: Revelation of John 11:10
segments: And they that dwell on the earth rejoice over them, and make merry; and they shall send gifts one to another; because these two prophets tormented them that dwell on the earth.

entries.title: Revelation of John 11:11
segments: And after the three days and a half the breath of life from God entered into them, and they stood upon their feet; and great fear fell upon them that beheld them.

entries.title: Revelation of John 11:12
segments: And they heard a great voice from heaven saying unto them, Come up hither. And they went up into heaven in the cloud; and their enemies beheld them.

entries.title: Revelation of John 11:13
segments: And in that hour there was a great earthquake, and the tenth part of the city fell; and there were killed in the earthquake seven thousand persons: and the rest were affrighted, and gave glory to the God of heaven.

entries.title: Revelation of John 11:14
segments: The second Woe is past: behold, the third Woe cometh quickly.

entries.title: Revelation of John 11:15
segments: And the seventh angel sounded; and there followed great voices in heaven, and they said, The kingdom of the world is become [the kingdom] of our Lord, and of his Christ: and he shall reign for ever and ever.

entries.title: Revelation of John 11:16
segments: And the four and twenty elders, who sit before God on their thrones, fell upon their faces and worshipped God,

entries.title: Revelation of John 11:17
segments: saying, We give thee thanks, O Lord God, the Almighty, who art and who wast; because thou hast taken thy great power, and didst reign.

entries.title: Revelation of John 11:18
segments: And the nations were wroth, and thy wrath came, and the time of the dead to be judged, and [the time] to give their reward to thy servants the prophets, and to the saints, and to them that fear thy name, the small and the great; and to destroy them that destroy the earth.

entries.title: Revelation of John 11:19
segments: And there was opened the temple of God that is in heaven; and there was seen in his temple the ark of his covenant; and there followed lightnings, and voices, and thunders, and an earthquake, and great hail.
